thread:
olivia: Quick FYI: during today's staged pricing pilot a small subset of canary accounts saw duplicate "pilot surcharge" invoice lines. Account samples: 20188, 20199, 20210. Need ops triage. :eyes:
aj: On it. Running quick DB check.

aj: Query:
```
SELECT invoice_id, COUNT(*) FROM invoice_lines WHERE label='pilot surcharge' AND created_at>'2026-03-22' GROUP BY invoice_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1;
```
Found 4 invoice_ids.

samir: That looks like a duplicate-insert from retry. Were these in cohort A only?
olivia: Yes A only. We paused the cohort flag for the pilot but a few drafts landed.

marie: We must follow grandfathering for legacy customers if any are in that sample. Confirm which accounts had legacy pricing mapped.
david: Immediate plan: 1) pause rollout (done?), 2) add short-term dedupe (label+amount+60s), 3) prepare reversing credit notes. Approve 1&2 now.
aj: Paused flag `pilot_surcharge_rollout` at 11:12 UTC. Added alert on duplicate-surcharge-lines. Implementing dedupe guard now.
olivia: For comms: draft to customers: "We've detected a duplicate surcharge on a small number of draft invoices during a pricing pilot. We've applied credits to correct this. No action required." Add billing@redwood.ai contact and ETA for credit: 48-72 hours.

marie: Finance OK on credits. Please cc finance@redwood.ai and include ledger reference.

billing-bot: Billing deploy rollback: v4.0.1 -> v4.0.0 at 11:16 UTC due to invoice-duplicates alert.

aj: I'll produce credits CSV and S3 path /mnt/billing/credits/2026-03-22/pilot-duplicate-credits.csv by 12:00 UTC. Also added rerun exclusion list for affected accounts.

samir: Postmortem items: make retry idempotent, ensure experiment gate does not double-run surcharge path, and include a canary out-of-band assertion for invoice line uniqueness.

david: Agree. Once credits apply, ops to exclude those invoices from any automated re-run. Marie please sign off on final ledger entries.

olivia: Thanks team. I'll send the customer notes and close loop when credits post. Will follow up with a short incident summary later. :thumbsup:
